text:
maria: heads-up: PR 8231 (quant kernel update) just landed a canary. i'm seeing a p95 tail bump on longseq workloads — ~18% higher than baseline on our internal bench. attaching results.

maria: bench artifact: https://internal.ci/redwood/bench/8231/canary-2026-03-16

maria: quick paste of the main diff from the microbench run:
```
model: longseq-13b
metric: p95 latency
baseline: 240ms
canary: 283ms (+18%)
throughput: 420 req/s -> 390 req/s (-7%)
memory: resident +120MB
```

chris: ouch. do we have traces? is it tail or steady-state increase?

maria: mostly tail — p50 unchanged. added traces in the artifact. looks correlated with kv cache refill after big context shifts.

perf-bot: canary report uploaded — 8231/canary/report.html (summary + graphs). 2 failing thresholds: p95-latency, throughput-drop.

samir: @maria can you drop the exact kernel commit? i want to diff the op-level timings.

maria: commit 1f4b9ae — change in quantized matmul tiling. timeline + op-level heatmap in the artifact.

laura: is this reproducing on dedicated pools or only the canary nodes? any mem-pressure patterns?

maria: so far only on canary group A (v3 gpus). canary B (v2 gpus) looks fine. resident mem up ~120MB on canary A during longseq runs.

chris: if it's tied to tiling strategy we might be seeing worse cache locality on that hw. can we run a focused microbench for matmul with long sequences? samir, can you spin that up on your rig?

samir: on it. running microbench now, will post numbers in ~20m. if reproduces, we can either revert or toggle tiling flag via runtime config.

maria: preference is to hold the merge until we have a mitigation. current canary is paused. also need approvals to revert quickly if necessary — @chris and @laura can you take a look?

chris: reading report… i can +1 to revert if samir's microbench shows the same pattern. hold for my +1.

laura: agree with hold. also want a quick impact note for Dedicated customers (do we need to notify?). i'll +1 to revert if perf bot confirms p95 regressed on v3.

perf-bot: update: separate bench on v3 nodes replicated p95 bump. details: 8231/canary/v3-heatmap.png

samir: microbench confirms: matmul-tiling v2 -> p95 +20% on long-k dims on v3. attaching run log.

maria: thanks. i'll open revert PR and tag you both for fast review. revert candidate: PR 8239.

chris: i'll review 8239 now. if clean, i'll approve and request urgent merge window.

laura: ack. i'll check customer impact doc and post a short note for CS if we merge revert.

samir: optional mitigation: runtime flag `--tiling=legacy` can be toggled per-deployment. could ship as hotfix to canary groups first.

maria: good idea. i'll prepare a canary config toggle as plan B if revert gets delayed.

chris: 5m after review: PR 8239 looks fine. +1 from me for revert. please include the perf regression notes in the PR description.

laura: +1. i'll coordinate CS email template if we flip the flag for production later.

maria: great — merging revert now (pending CI). will post update when done and re-run canary. thanks everyone :heart:
